d.ko: Step into Japan's criminal underworld in this explosive action brawler starring legendary yakuza, Kazuma Kiryu, who is hellbent on unraveling the truth around his daughter's tragic accident.
d.en: Step into Japan's criminal underworld in this explosive action brawler starring legendary yakuza, Kazuma Kiryu, who is hellbent on unraveling the truth around his daughter's tragic accident.
d.zh: 为了家族，何谓“赴汤蹈火”？在这款拳拳到肉的劲爆打斗动作游戏中，走进日本的黑道世界，扮演“传说中的黑道”桐生一马，誓死查出导致女儿陷入昏迷的真相。
